The doctor gave me good advice when I had the extraction. After the extraction, the tooth was loose and wobbly in the morning. I called the doctor the next day to tell him to come see the dentist who performed the extraction. It would be better. I waited another day to see the dentist again. I was really afraid of having it extracted. It was a chipped tooth in the front, which was embarrassing.
EP2: I asked about the cost of the extraction: 600 baht + 200 baht for the medicine.
The loose tooth wasn't loose, it was just not fully developed because it was extracted from the adjacent tooth.
